title: Photographs of alien objects on Mars, including a 'square'

tellings.quote: I have probably somewhere in the neighborhood of 60 something photographs of things on Mars that are clearly alien

plain: Joe McMoneagle, who worked as a psychic spy for the US Army, says he has around sixty photographs of things on Mars that are "clearly alien", among them an object shaped like a square. He tells this on Michels's show about his own collection. If true, it would mean something built by a non-human intelligence sits on Mars.
